retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast urban portrait style featuring subjects emerging from deep shadows with a distinct olive-green and black duotone-like color grade.
triggerTerms: urban group portrait with harsh lighting

recipe.visualDefinition: A three-person group portrait in profile, heavily shadowed on the left, transitioning into a textured olive-green background with bold, blocky typography featuring deep offset shadows.
coreVisualRelationships: Subjects positioned in the right two-thirds of the frame
Deep black negative space on the left third
Harsh directional lighting creating strong highlights and deep shadows
Typography anchored to the top-left corner
coreInvariants: Heavy black drop shadows on all text elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects in profile, staggered from right to center, occupying the vertical height of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright highlights on the rightmost subject's face and shirt.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bold text in the top left, down the diagonal line of the subjects' heads toward the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant black void on the left side of the composition.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black for shadows and negative space.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Muted olive green for highlights and background texture.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale cream or off-white for text and brightest highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between deep blacks and bright highlights.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Unified family with varying color and scale.
graphicDevices: Deep offset drop shadows creating a 3D effect

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, geometric 90s aesthetic perfectly.
Provides the necessary horizontal stretch and blocky feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of three men in profile, staggered from right to left. Use harsh directional lighting from the right, casting the left side of the image into deep black shadow. Apply an olive-green and black duotone-style color grade with film grain texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two levels of text in the top-left corner using an extended bold sans-serif font. The top text should be olive-green and the bottom text cream. Apply a thick, hard-edged black drop shadow offset to the bottom right of all letters.

verificationChecks: Is the left third of the image predominantly black?
Does the text have a heavy, hard-edged black drop shadow?
Is the color palette restricted to olive, cream, and black?
Are the subjects in profile facing left?

adjustableVariables: Number of subjects in the portrait
mustRedesign: Avoid using specific artist names or logos
Ensure the background texture is not a flat color but has a wall-like grit

mustAchieve: High contrast between light and shadow

postGenerationChecks: Check that text is legible against the shadow
Verify the duotone effect covers the entire image
Ensure the drop shadow is offset and not a glow
Confirm the subjects are positioned on the right
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Olive/Black Duotone + Extended Bold Sans-Serif + Heavy Drop Shadow
